message:
test(dlss): execute actual renderer promotion, isolated recording and restore

Retain real renderer target ownership, shader composition, slot rotation,
video submission and fence waits in a headless Vulkan fixture. Replace only
the vendor recording callback under a fixture-only macro, with no runtime
option to bypass color qualification. Recheck Unknown at dispatch boundary.

Exercise typed temporal images, guest alpha, a native-size post-SR marker,
isolated failure exclusion, ordinary Flush, restore upload rollover, and
depth, alias, growth, frame and epoch transitions. No NGX/game acceptance claimed.
